newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sri Trang to build Thai block rubber plant.
newsitem.headline: Sri Trang to build Thai block rubber plant.

text.p: Sri Trang Agro Industry Plc, a Thai agri-business firm, will invest 200 million baht on the building of a block rubber plant, a company official said on Wednesday.
The plant, scheduled to be completed during the first quarter of 1998, will produce 48,000 tonnes of STR (Standard Thai Rubber) a year, she told Reuters. MORE ak/ram
"We are aware that the rubber demand trend is shifting toward block rubber from sheet rubber which is Thailand's current major rubber production," the official said.
"Therefore, our decision is to catch up with this trend," she said.
Sri Trang Agro presently produces around 55,000 tonnes of smoked sheet rubber a year, mostly for export.
The official said the company would raise funds locally to finance the project.
